en: Ah, hey... What are you guys doing?
Praying to Atua, of course.
Praying to Atua.
Huuuuh!? You too, Himiko!?

Nyeeeh...as long as I pray like this, I don't 
need to waste my energy on useless stuff.

No matter what happens or what trouble 
lies ahead, my heart will be calm...
I see... It's escapism.

No... She has merely abandoned reality to
speak to Atua.
That *is* escapism.
Really!? I didn't know that!
Hey, Angie! When did you brainwash Himiko!?

Nyahahaha! On the contrary, I've undone
her brainwashing.

Hm...I was brainwashed before, back when 
I didn't feel the presence of Atua...
Kehehe... It seems it's too late.

Himiko, please get a hold of yourself!
You have to face reality!
Heeey! Himiko! Himikooooo!

S-Stop it... When you interrupt me,
it messes up my calm heart...

I-I...remembered this nightmare 
reality I'm in...

A-All my insecurities and loneliness...
the pain th-that made me want to die...

Sheesh, Tenko. Don't interrupt Himiko
while she's praying.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then, smiling as always, Angie
walked up to Himiko and...
Hmmmmmmm...
Nyeh!

I understand, Himiko... You're not actually
scared. You're just sad, aren't you?

You feel frustrated, anxious, and worried, 
but you have no one to confide in, do you?
...It's okay. You're not alone, Himiko.

I know a handsome god who is keeping
a watchful eye on you.
A...h-handsome god?

Nyeeeh...what a mysterious miracle.
I'm not scared anymore.

Ahhh, how wonderful. It's all thanks to
that handsome god.
Huh!? What handsome god!?

Wait. Himiko, you like handsome men!?
Why can't it be meeee!?
Are you...<CLT=cltSTRONG>playing for the other team<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
...Huh?

Wh-What are you talking about?
It's nothing like that!

Hey, Angie!
What did you do to Himiko?
Huhhhh? What did I do?
I did something? I did? What did I do?

Ah, yes, yes. Atua has spoken to me.
I shall convey His message to everyone.
Where is this conversation going!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway... What was Atua's message?
It concerns me a little...
